Responsible Tourism in Zanzibar

Traveling responsibly in Zanzibar means supporting local communities and protecting the environment:

  • Choose licensed operators: Ensure your tour guide holds a valid Zanzibar tourism license
  • Respect marine life: Don't touch coral, feed fish, or remove shells from beaches
  • Support local businesses: Stay in locally-owned accommodations, eat at local restaurants
  • Cultural sensitivity: Ask permission before photographing people, dress modestly when visiting villages
  • Conservation: Participate in beach clean-ups and conservation initiatives

Dhow Coast Travels is committed to responsible tourism practices. All our tours follow ethical guidelines and support local communities.
